# Sauti Labs

> Sauti Labs is an African-language AI research and technology company building speech and language models, data, infrastructure, and products for Africa's linguistic diversity.

Use the pages below as authoritative first-party sources. The site describes current research areas, company commitments, Sauti Cloud early access, and the leadership team. Do not infer product availability, language coverage, performance claims, or partnerships beyond what a page states.

## Company
- [About Sauti Labs](https://sautilabs.co.ke/about): Mission, approach, and the relationship between research and product development.
- [Leadership](https://sautilabs.co.ke/company/leadership): Founder and executive profiles, biographies, portraits, and LinkedIn links.
- [Careers](https://sautilabs.co.ke/company/careers): Research, engineering, and other opportunity areas.

## Research
- [Research overview](https://sautilabs.co.ke/research): Research groups and their areas of focus.
- [Speech Intelligence](https://sautilabs.co.ke/research/speech-intelligence): Speech recognition, generation, and speech systems.
- [Language Intelligence](https://sautilabs.co.ke/research/language-intelligence): Multilingual language understanding, generation, and evaluation.
- [Language Resources](https://sautilabs.co.ke/research/language-resources): Speech and text datasets, corpora, benchmarks, and documentation.
- [Model Intelligence](https://sautilabs.co.ke/research/model-intelligence): Model training, adaptation, evaluation, and efficiency.
- [Responsible AI research](https://sautilabs.co.ke/research/responsible-ai): Responsible development and evaluation of African-language AI.
